whoItsFor: Developers and power users with consumer hardware, such as gaming PCs, laptops, or workstation GPUs, who want to run large open-weight MoE models locally. It is also aimed at people who want to connect those local models to coding and tool-calling agents.
useCases: Running frontier open-weight MoE models (290B+) locally on a gaming PC
Serving local models to coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, or OpenCode via Anthropic/OpenAI-compatible APIs
Local tool-calling agent workflows with cached context reuse across agentic edits

requirements.runtime: Python (for CLI install via uv or pip)
